guide.samogon.title: Distiller's Guide
guide.samogon.body: Chain: malt -> wort -> fermentation -> wash -> pot still -> heads/hearts/tails -> reflux column -> filter -> dilution basin -> blend -> aging. The blending table has five slots: berries, honey, beetroot, potato, seeds, herbs, mushrooms and more. Empty-hand right-click opens the machine interface; right-click with an item is the quick manual path. Golden sparkles mean the product is ready. The thermometer and hydrometer report process values. This is a game simulation, not a real production guide.
guide.samogon.book.title: DISTILLER'S GUIDE
guide.samogon.book.subtitle: copper & oak
guide.samogon.page.raw.title: Raw materials
guide.samogon.page.raw.malt: Malt: grain origin, +4 quality. Base wash about 11.5%%.
guide.samogon.page.raw.wheat: Wheat: grain origin, no bonus. Base wash about 11.5%%.
guide.samogon.page.raw.sugar: Sugar: sugar origin, -4 quality. Base wash about 13.5%%.
guide.samogon.page.raw.berries: Sweet berries: berry origin, +2 quality. Base about 10.5%%.
guide.samogon.page.raw.honey: Honey bottle: honey origin, +6 quality, returns the glass bottle. Base about 12.5%%.
guide.samogon.page.raw.summary: One portion -> 2000 units of wort. After fermentation about 1900 units of wash; one jar holds 1000.
guide.samogon.page.raw.tip: Base strength is before temperature. 20 C is best; heat hurts quality and raises impurities.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.title: Troubleshooting
guide.samogon.page.trouble.heat: The tun does not heat: fire or a lit campfire must be directly below it.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.ferment: Fermentation stalled: keep 8-38 C. A campfire warms; ice cools.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.still: The still is silent: wash 100+, heat below, water bucket in the condenser.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.cuts: The still puked: lower the heat, refill coolant, and keep the cuts apart.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.column: The column is weak: feed low wines and heat below; a sieve gives 99.5%%.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.basin: The basin rejects it: spirit must be above 40%%; final volume up to 4000.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.bottle: Cannot bottle: bottle in output. Glow and sparkles mean ready.
guide.samogon.page.trouble.tip: Empty hand: panel. Shift+right-click: quick action. Meters: values.
guide.samogon.page.overview.title: Full cycle
guide.samogon.page.overview.lead: Seven stages, fire and time. From malt to the oak cask.
guide.samogon.page.overview.tip: Empty-hand right-click: panel. Light and sparkles: ready.
guide.samogon.page.mash.title: Wash
guide.samogon.page.mash.step1: Malt into the tun, heat below. 20 sec.
guide.samogon.page.mash.step2: Bottle the wort, then add yeast.
guide.samogon.page.mash.step3: 5 min at 20 °C. Bottle the finished wash.
guide.samogon.page.mash.tip: 8–38 °C is the working range. Heat or cold stalls fermentation.
guide.samogon.page.mash.note: Progress stuck? Check the heat under the tun and the air around the barrel.
guide.samogon.page.still.title: Distilling
guide.samogon.page.still.bar.caption: the cuts come in order
guide.samogon.page.still.step1: Wash into the pot; water in the condenser is required.
guide.samogon.page.still.step3: Change the receiver with the interface button or Shift-right-click.
guide.samogon.page.still.step4: Hearts into a bottle. Heads and tails are technical.
guide.samogon.page.still.note: Light and sparkles mean ready. Do not clear the pot before the cuts are bottled.
guide.samogon.page.clean.title: Cleaning
guide.samogon.page.clean.step1: Low wines (20–35%%) into the column, heat below.
guide.samogon.page.clean.step2: A molecular sieve raises the strength to 99.5%% ABV.
guide.samogon.page.clean.step3: Spirit and charcoal into the filter.
guide.samogon.page.clean.step4: 30 sec. Check the strength with a hydrometer.
guide.samogon.page.clean.tip: The column takes about 60 sec. If strength is low, add a sieve and repeat.
guide.samogon.page.dilute.title: Dilution
guide.samogon.page.dilute.gauge.caption: target 40%% ABV
guide.samogon.page.dilute.step2: A water bucket starts 10 sec of mixing.
guide.samogon.page.dilute.step4: Bottle it for blending or the cask. The basin holds up to 4000 units.
guide.samogon.page.dilute.tip: Hearts or clean spirit only. Never dilute heads and tails.
guide.samogon.page.blend.title: Blending
guide.samogon.page.blend.tag: five additives | a character of its own
guide.samogon.page.blend.ingredients: berries | honey | beetroot | potato | seeds | herbs
guide.samogon.page.blend.step2: Fill up to five slots: berries, honey, beetroot, potato, seeds, herbs.
guide.samogon.page.blend.step3: Press "Blend" or Shift+right-click with an empty hand.
guide.samogon.page.blend.tip: Composition shapes the name and character. Above 60%%: dilute in the basin. Tinctures give bonuses at III+.
guide.samogon.page.age.title: Aging
guide.samogon.page.age.gauge.caption: strength 20–60%%
guide.samogon.page.age.step1: Spirit at 20–60%% ABV into the cask.
guide.samogon.page.age.tip: Hearts or blend only, never heads and tails.
guide.samogon.page.memo.title: Cheat sheet
guide.samogon.page.memo.safety: A game, not a guide. In real life, never drink heads or tails.
